name: Woodrow
title: Weapon Merchant

merchant/30837.htm.text: Trader Woodrow: Welcome, customer! Welcome to Aden, the largest and most splendid city on the continent! As you have already seen, this town is surrounded by a magnificent wall, which is supported by massive columns. Beautiful and practical -- how could our capital have less?
merchant/30837.htm.dpText: Trader Woodrow: Hello, customer! Welcome to Aden, the largest and most splendid city on the continent! Doesn't it take your breath away? The perfect setting for the capital of the whole kingdom!

links.text: Ask about the local lord and tax rate.

merchant/30837-1.htm.text: Trader Woodrow: There must be something you need. What can I bring you?
merchant/30837-1.htm.dpText: Trader Woodrow: There must be something here you like! What can I do for you?

merchant/30837-pk.htm.text: Trader Woodrow: Get out of here! I don't have the time or patience for the likes of you! I only cater to a dignified clientele. Leave immediately or I shall call the guards!

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30837-01.html.text: Trader Woodrow: Ah, you mean the flute that Swan ordered? It must have arrived at Giran Harbor by now... If you're in a hurry, you can go directly to the harbor and pick it up. I'll give you the item number so you can pick it up from Gallion at the harbor.

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30837-02.html.text: Trader Woodrow: Didn't you say that you desperately need the flute? It will take a long time for it to be shipped here. Why don't you go directly to Giran Harbor and pick it up? Give the item number I gave you to Gallion at the harbor.

Q00362_BardsMandolin/30837-03.html.text: Trader Woodrow: So, we meet again! Please give my regards to Mr. Swan.
